items.recapEn: In an Arimatsu shibori workshop Kojima-san, seventy, explained what cannot be hurried: indigo rested a hundred days, a thousand knots tied by hand, dyeing and drying no machine can shorten. Ken could not refuse a binding lesson and tied a terrible cloth; she said so. Hana saw that time is an ingredient. Kojima-san kept the cloth: collect it next month.

items.recapEn: Walking on to Narumi, Ken admitted he could not say no to Kojima-san; Hana teased him with the day's grammar, and he "could not deny it". A stew, he said, is not hurried by a bigger flame: time is an ingredient. He now has a reason to stay near Nagoya: the cloth comes back next month.
